posts.text:
friday was my last day at @initia.

im grateful to have had the opportunity to work alongside such a talented team, and to everyone who read, challenged, and supported the marketing we made over the past year and a half.

Like many of you, my faith in this industry has been https://t.co/QOt6FAZlxm

we should go back to family creeds and the pursuit of grandiose visions and near unattainable life goals.

“what is rare?” feels like the perfect fit

something can be rare because of when it exists, what it’s made of, who made it, or a thousand things that had to come together https://t.co/AejehpfelE

Answered some hot questions about @TradeOnStrat 👀

Happy to chat if you've got more :) https://t.co/fnK2XaBRDA
